title: Data Analyst
description:
Wabash Analytics helps regional retailers understand their customers.

What you'll do
- Build recurring reports and dashboards for client teams
- Answer ad-hoc questions with SQL

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (math, statistics, economics, computer science)
- Strong SQL
- Experience with Python or R
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI
- 1+ years of experience in an analytics role

Nice to have
- dbt
- Snowflake
